title: Looping over keys and pairs
description: You can read the same dictionary through two loop forms.

steps.description: menu stores three item-price pairs. Looping over menu directly gives you each key as item.
You look up menu[item] to get the current key's price. The first loop prints one costs sentence per entry.

steps.question: What values does the second loop assign to item and price for coffee?
steps.answer: It assigns coffee to item and 3 to price. items supplies each key and value together.

steps.description: You see coffee: $3, bagel: $2 and muffin: $4 after the first three sentences. Both loops read the same entries with different formatting.
